title: Monopoly Boards Secretly Helped Prisoners Escape In WW2 🎲
caption:
Monopoly boards secretly helped prisoners escape 🎲
Wait for the ending 👀

True story. In World War Two British intelligence (MI9) had the games maker Waddington hide escape kits in Monopoly sets for prisoners of war: silk maps, compasses, files and real money under the fake money. Airmen were told to look for the Monopoly set if captured.
Would you have spotted it? 👇
first_comment: Get out of jail free, for real. Would you have spotted the hidden map? 🎲👇
